source_review.notes: Checked current official Apache Spark lazy RDD, Spark Connect analysis-timing, and SQL tuning documentation; Dask Delayed, lazy interfaces, computation phases, and high-level graphs; Apache Beam model, pipeline construction, and programming guide; and Apache Calcite algebra and DuckDB EXPLAIN documentation. All twelve URLs returned HTTP 200 on the retrieval date. Sources support lazy transformation/action boundaries, unresolved and analyzed plans, graph construction, optimization, shared computation, explainability, and planning-overhead claims.

evidence: Reviewed lazy handle H, unresolved/analyzed/optimized logical plans, physical and observed runtime plans, selected-sink dependency closure, and construction/analysis/execution times.
Reviewed canonical-plan digest, identity components, joint-action memoization, source-read count, snapshots, functions, policies, and effect contracts.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Lazy handles, their future values, metadata triggers, actions, persistence hints, materialized partitions, and durable outputs remain distinct.

evidence: Executed lazy-plan-boundary with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced canonical display sum(map_square(filter_even(source[numbers]))).
Recomputed SHA-256 display prefix c9f2d8b57e3f, first and second totals of 20, even count 2, and source reads zero before action then one, two, and three.
Confirmed the joint action evaluates shared source/filter lineage once through one memo while independent actions each use a fresh memo.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The demo digest is explicitly incomplete as production identity and the local memo does not claim distributed persistence semantics.

evidence: Checked action dependency closure by backward reachability and verified unselected pure branches may be pruned.
Reviewed observational equivalence across values, ordering, errors, nondeterminism, policy, and effects for logical rewrites.
Checked reuse identity as a conjunction over operators, parameters, ordered inputs, snapshots, schemas, code/functions, configuration, nondeterminism, user/purpose/policy, and output contract.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Textual or digest equality is not treated as semantic proof when canonical identity omits relevant context or collision handling.

evidence: Reviewed empty and unused branches, multiple sinks, mandatory audit/error output, repeated versus joint actions, partial caches, eviction, source drift, catalog drift, and adaptive plans.
Reviewed missing columns under eager/deferred analysis, closure mutation, large captures, unsupported serialization, clocks/randomness, unordered input, floating reassociation, and hidden effects.
Reviewed million-node plans, deep expressions, large literals, catalog RPCs, unbounded collect, driver memory/transport, credentials in closures, row-policy cache leakage, retry, and cancellation.

evidence: Traced logical/analyzed/optimized/physical/observed plan identities with code, dependencies, schemas, functions, catalogs, snapshots, seeds/clocks, configuration, resources, security context, attempts, and outputs.
Checked optimizer rules use explicit semantic guards and selected sinks include required dependency and effect closure.
Checked local collection, common-subplan reuse, persistence, replay, retention, deletion, and policy admission preserve capacity and isolation invariants.
invariant_checking.notes: Dynamic alias resolution and intentionally adaptive behavior require recorded resolution and decision evidence rather than implicit current state.

evidence: Reviewed the ten-step audit from operation classification and temporal capture through analysis, canonicalization, rewrites, physical planning, bounds, repeated/joint actions, and replay.

Checked counterexamples for handles-as-data, lazy-all-driver-work, universal deferred errors, cache-as-durability, automatic cross-action sharing, live closure assumptions, plan-string replay, textual reuse, explain-as-observed-plan, and once-only map effects.
Reviewed reference-plan equivalence and conjunctive reuse proofs, including policy and effect observability.
proof_review.notes: Relational value equality alone is not accepted when ordering, errors, nondeterminism, authorization, or external effects are part of the contract.

evidence: Audited uses of lazy, pure, immutable, unresolved, analyzed, canonical, equivalent, deterministic, identical, shared, bounded, persisted, durable, adaptive, and replayable.
Confirmed the executable evaluator is labeled as a local action-boundary model rather than a distributed optimizer, cache, serializer, or policy engine.

evidence: Reviewed construction CPU/memory, nodes/edges/depth, plan and closure bytes, catalog RPC/time, optimizer iterations/time, submission, source reads, cache hit/miss/eviction, driver rows/bytes, retries, and output evidence.
Confirmed no universal closure limit, plan-size limit, cache threshold, collection bound, rewrite benefit, error timing, scheduler behavior, legal approval, or external-review claim is made.
